exposure: early cervical cerclage (11+0 to 15+6 weeks gestation)
late cervical cerclage (16+0 to 19+6 weeks gestation)
cohort: 499 singleton pregnancies complicated by cervical incompetence who underwent prophylactic cervical cerclage.
finding: The efficacy and risks of prophylactic cervical cerclage performed between 16+0 to 19+6 weeks of gestation were comparable to those of earlier cerclage performed between 11+0 to 15+6 weeks.
mod_finding: The incidence rates of cesarean section were comparable between the early and late cerclage groups.
birth_weight: Median (IQR) 3080.0 (2652.5-3450.0) g for early cerclage and 3210.0 (2600.0-3550.0) g for late cerclage.
gest_age: Median (IQR) gestational age at delivery 38.1 (36.6-39.1) weeks for early cerclage and 38.3 (37.1-39.0) weeks for late cerclage.
